page.layout: One page of text, single column; the digitiser's banner (logo at top right) and cover-sheet blocks are not transcribed.
page.notes: This is a digitiser's cover sheet from the Göttingen State and University Library (SUB), not a printed page of the 1607 book. Its blocks are: a "Werk" (work metadata) block, a "Terms and Conditions" block and a "Contact" block. The SUB logo/banner at the top is a digitiser's banner and is omitted. The metadata and terms are printed on the cover sheet, not in the early modern book, so per the rules they are not transcribed as main text. The work itself is Keckermannus, Bartholomaeus, Systema Disciplinae Politicae, Hanoviae, Antonius, 1607 (VD17, PPN596019955). No printed page of the book is present on this scan.
